name: list_attachments
description: List the files the user attached to the current conversation. Returns each file's file_id, name and size. Call this first to discover attachments before reading them.

description_locale.zh: 列出用户在当前对话中上传的附件文件，返回每个文件的 file_id、文件名和大小。读取附件内容前先调用本工具。
description_locale.en: List the files the user attached to the current conversation. Returns each file's file_id, name and size. Call this first to discover attachments before reading them.

name: read_attachment
description: Read the text content of an uploaded file by file_id. Supported formats: txt, md, docx, pptx, msg (Outlook). Large files are paged by line — use offset to read further pages. Use this instead of bash/read_file for uploaded files.

description_locale.zh: 按 file_id 读取上传文件的文本内容。支持格式：txt、md、docx、pptx、msg（Outlook 邮件）。大文件按行分页——使用 offset 读取后续页。读取上传文件请用本工具，不要用 bash 或 read_file。
description_locale.en: Read the text content of an uploaded file by file_id. Supported formats: txt, md, docx, pptx, msg (Outlook). Large files are paged by line — use offset to read further pages. Use this instead of bash/read_file for uploaded files.

file_id.description: The file_id of the uploaded file (from list_attachments)

offset.description: 1-based line number to start reading from (default: 1)

limit.description: Maximum number of lines to return (default: 2000)
